ogre.name: Ground Slam
ogre.description: Hits every hero for its damage −2 and knocks its target prone

netShot.name: Net Shot
netShot.description: Hits the lowest-armor hero and nets them: they can't use an attack next round (utilities still work)

titheBlessing.name: Tithe Blessing
titheBlessing.description: Adds 3 coins to the sleeping Dragon's hoard. Once the hoard is sealed, it has no special

dragon.name: Fire Breath
dragon.description: Breathes fire over the whole party: every hero takes its full damage (armor still helps)

boulderToss.name: Boulder Toss
boulderToss.description: Hurls a boulder over your front line at the lowest-HP hero other than the Warrior for 1.25× its damage, knocking them prone. Taunts can't stop it

spearThrow.name: Spear Throw
spearThrow.description: One huge spear at the lowest-armor hero for 1.5× its damage

giantLord.name: Avalanche
giantLord.description: Brings the mountain down: every hero takes its damage −3 and loses 2 energy

goblinToss.name: Goblin Toss
goblinToss.description: Hurls one of its goblins over your front line at the lowest-HP hero for 1.5× its damage (taunts can't stop a throw; the goblin is spent). With no goblins left, it uses Ground Slam instead

assassin.name: Execute
assassin.description: Double damage to a hero below half HP

warlock.name: Hex
warlock.description: Curses the party (−2 damage for 2 turns) and deals 3 to every hero, ignoring armor

shaman.name: War Drum
shaman.description: Beats the drum before the horde acts: every monster deals +2 damage this round

chieftain.name: Call the Pack
chieftain.description: Two fresh goblins join the fight

raiseDead.name: Raise Dead
raiseDead.description: Every skeleton that crumbled from weapon hits rises again at 2 HP, fighting from next round. Fire and holy kills stay down

lich.name: Death Bolt
lich.description: Blasts the lowest-HP hero for 1.5× damage, ignoring armor

packTactics.name: Pack Tactics
packTactics.description: +1 damage for each other goblin minion on the field

packGuard.name: Guarded by the Pack
packGuard.description: Can't be targeted while 2 or more goblins are alive; attacks that hit every enemy still land

chieftainCommand.name: Chieftain's Command
chieftainCommand.description: Every goblin deals +1 damage while the Chieftain lives

restlessDead.name: Restless Dead
restlessDead.description: A fallen skeleton reassembles at the start of next round with half its HP: 8, 4, then 2. At 2 HP the next hit ends it. Fire and holy damage destroy it for good

phylactery.name: Phylactery
phylactery.description: The Lich takes half damage while its Phylactery stands. The Phylactery can't be targeted while any skeleton stands (attacks that hit every enemy still land)

hoardTithe.name: Hoard Tithe
hoardTithe.description: While the Dragon sleeps, each kobold still standing at the end of a round adds a coin to its hoard. Every 3 coins give the Dragon +1 damage (up to +5). Waking the Dragon seals the hoard

dragonscale.name: Dragonscale
dragonscale.description: Dragonkin take half damage from fire

dragonSleep.name: Asleep
dragonSleep.description: Sleeps on its hoard until the final wave arrives or a hero hits it. While asleep it takes extra damage (an ambush), and attacks that hit every enemy pass it by. A hit wakes it at the end of that round, and if it survives it answers at once with Rude Awakening: Fire Breath over the whole party at 1.5× damage. Then it's groggy: one action a round until the final wave arrives

topple.name: Topple
topple.description: Deal 50% of a giant's max HP in one round and it's toppled: it loses its next action, and a special about to fire is cancelled. It shakes the hall as it lands: every hero takes 2 damage. The count resets each round
